title: Dysautonomia and small fiber neuropathy in post-COVID condition and Chronic Fatigue Syndrome
abstract_summary: Comparativa de síntomas autonómicos/neuropáticos (POTS, SFN) y cognitivos entre pacientes post-COVID, ME/CFS y controles sanos.
document_text_extract: Background: Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS) and post-COVID condition are debilitating syndromes sharing clinical symptoms such as fatigue, cognitive impairment ('brain fog'), and autonomic and neuropathic symptoms... [Full abstract or extensive text extract here]... Conclusions: Autonomic symptoms and POTS are frequently found in both syndromes. Heat latency values point towards unmyelinated fibre damage, and palm Sudoscan results suggest a non-length-dependent SFN in these patients.
